hero.subtitle: A VR adventure built to walk beside children fighting cancer turning treatment days into hero's journeys.

mission.p1: <holo>Bookatoon</holo> was born from the belief that no child should lose the ability to dream, imagine, and find hope while facing a health challenge, more than a game, Bookatoon is an original transmedia universe designed to inspire courage, resilience, and perseverance through memorable characters, music, stories, games, and immersive experience.
mission.p2: Its first chapter began with the humanization of pediatric oncology care, but its vision extends far beyond cancer-creating meaningful experiences that support children and families throughout their healthcare journey. The first Bookatoon experience is a therapeutic gamification platform developed by <plasma>Goblin Studios</plasma>, with scientific and institucional support from <holo>Hospital de Amor</holo>, one of Latin America's leading cancer treatment and research centers.
mission.p3: Together, they combine creativity, technology, and clinical expertise to build a global entertainment franchise that transforms storytelling into a source of hope, empowering children to discover that the light to overcome life's greatest challenges has always existed within themselves.

hero.sectionLabel: HOW WE THINK · HOW WE WORK
hero.subtitle: We're not a agency. We're not a vendor. We're a crew, with a code.

body: OUR CREED.
Great games don't need giant studios.
AAA talent is finding new homes: smaller, sharper, more specialized.
The walls got smaller.
The standards never did.
Tools change. Craft doesn't.
Great games are made by people who care deeply about every detail.
Technology should amplify their talent, never replace it.
Better workflows. Never shortcuts.
Players don't care how big the team was. They care if the game is good.
Budgets are tighter, timelines shorter, expectations higher.
Focused teams can now reach world-class quality.
Not by working less. By working smarter.
We don't join projects as suppliers. We join as part of the team.
Built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership.
Your challenges become ours.
So do your victories.
Question conventions. Respect the craft. Stay curious. Protect quality.
Share knowledge and build worlds worth remembering.
Because great studios aren't measured by their size.
They're measured by the legacy they leave behind.

quote.text: Find something to believe in, and find it for yourself. When you do, pass it on to the future.
quote.author: Hideo Kojima

body: We believe craft outlives trends.
We believe discipline fuels creativity.
We believe small teams can build extraordinary things.
We believe every discipline deserves respect.
We believe knowledge exists to be shared.
We believe trust builds great partnerships.
We believe quality lives in every decision.
We believe every game deserves to become someone's favorite.
